title: Entrepreneurship and strategy
learning_outcomes: Explain strategic diagnosis in the context of entrepreneurship and strategy.
Compare and distinguish competitive options in the context of entrepreneurship and strategy.
Apply coherent actions in the context of entrepreneurship and strategy.
Evaluate and justify decisions about ethical and financial risks in the context of entrepreneurship and strategy.

lessons.title: Strategic diagnosis
lessons.outcome: Explain strategic diagnosis in the context of entrepreneurship and strategy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving strategic diagnosis; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to venture strategy memo.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain strategic diagnosis from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of strategic diagnosis; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Competitive options
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish competitive options in the context of entrepreneurship and strategy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving competitive options; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to venture strategy memo.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain competitive options from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of competitive options; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Coherent actions
lessons.outcome: Apply coherent actions in the context of entrepreneurship and strategy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving coherent actions; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to venture strategy memo.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain coherent actions from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of coherent actions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Ethical and financial risks
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about ethical and financial risks in the context of entrepreneurship and strategy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving ethical and financial risks; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to venture strategy memo.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain ethical and financial risks from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of ethical and financial risks; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of strategic diagnosis; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of competitive options; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of coherent actions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of ethical and financial risks; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Practitioner with relevant business, technology or privacy expertise.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
